verdict.rationale: Docs show only piecemeal export options—notes to Google Docs/Sheets, audio overview downloads, and slide decks as PDF—but no evidence of a full data export (sources, chat history, citations, mind maps) or a genuine 'leave the platform' workflow in open, portable formats. Missing for 10: bulk/full-notebook export, open-format guarantees (vs Google Docs/Sheets lock-in), and any documentation or community confirmation of a complete account data export/exit path.
